design_system.name: Comber Home Clocking System
design_system.description: A strict visual clone of Frappe HRMS/Desk tailored for Kiosk usage.

variants.default: bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary/90 h-9 px-4 py-2
variants.outline: border border-input bg-background hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground h-9 px-4 py-2
variants.kiosk_primary: bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary/90 h-16 text-xl w-full shadow-md
variants.kiosk_secondary: bg-white border-2 border-gray-200 text-gray-900 hover:bg-gray-50 h-16 text-xl w-full

Input.base: flex h-9 w-full rounded-md border border-input bg-transparent px-3 py-1 text-sm shadow-sm transition-colors file:border-0 file:bg-transparent file:text-sm file:font-medium placeholder:text-muted-foreground focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-1 focus-visible:ring-ring disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50

Badge.base: inline-flex items-center rounded-full border px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-semibold transition-colors focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-ring focus:ring-offset-2

instructions_to_main_agent: STRICTLY follow the Frappe HRMS visual style: Clean white cards on light gray background.
For Kiosk pages (Login, PIN), use the 'kiosk' variants of components (larger sizes).
For Dashboard pages, use the standard 'default' variants.
Ensure high contrast for all text (Gray-900 for headings, Gray-600 for body).
Do not use gradients or rounded-xl/2xl/3xl. Stick to rounded-md or rounded-lg.
Use Lucide React icons: 'LayoutDashboard' for Desk, 'Users' for Staff, 'Settings' for Admin.
Implement a 'Scan Login' page as the root ('/') with a mock camera view if real camera is not available.
Mock the backend data for Staff, Attendance, and Shifts.
Ensure the 'Offline' indicator is visible in the top bar.
universal_guidelines: Avoid 'AI slop' - no generic centered layouts for the dashboard. Use a proper sidebar layout.
Do not use 'transition: all'. Animate specific properties.
